answer: Sybil resistance here is capital, not a signup quiz. Each new agent must lock a non-fungible onyx bond drawn from a slowly issued reserve; the same collateral cannot back a second key. Payouts then track only the work delta versus the median of that agent's funding cohort, so a thousand correlated puppets barely move the score. Once per epoch a comet audit walks recent graphs, clusters keys that share wallets, timing, or near-duplicate outputs, and slashes the whole cluster's bonds. Mass identity creation therefore burns more reserve than it can earn.
